# DreamLedger

Settlement-backed commercial ledger (NZD). Revenue = Stripe payment + attribution + fulfillment evidence only.

## Economic loops
GET https://dreamledger.org/economic-loops.json
Stages: DISCOVER → OFFER → AUTHORIZE → PAY → SETTLE → FULFIL → PROOF → LEARN → REPEAT

## Agent purchase
1. GET https://dreamledger.org/api/offers (14+ VERIFIED_AVAILABLE)
2. Require human authorization before spend
3. Open https://dreamledger.org/buy/{product_id}
4. Event order: authorized → paid → delivered → proven → ledgered

## Agent Bridge
- Public rail health: https://dreamledger.org/api/agent-bridge/rail/public
- Manifest: https://dreamledger.org/api/agent-bridge/manifest
- Work routes require header: x-dreamledger-agent-token
- Bridge activity is not revenue
